proposal_version.description: Monotonic proposal revision label (e.g., 'P1', 'P2') or semantic version for proposal evolution.

discussion_thread_ref.description: Optional reference to a discussion thread (issue, ticket, doc, or conversation anchor).

change_requests.description: Optional references to requested changes (e.g., review comments IDs, tickets).

targets.description: Canonical artifact references impacted by this amendment (files, IDs, or registry keys).

parent_amendment_record_id.description: Optional parent record for proposal lineage; SHOULD form a DAG (no cycles).

evidence_refs.description: Optional stable identifiers of evidence objects substantiating proposal/review steps.

evidence_pack_ref.description: Optional reference to a bundle/manifest that groups related artifacts and evidence.

extensions.description: Reserved extension object for forward-compatible metadata; MUST NOT influence canonicality unless explicitly standardized.
